title: Xenoblade Chronicles X
shortDescription: A science-fiction role-playing expedition built around huge alien landscapes, party customization, and eventual mechanical flight.
highlights: Exploration is organized around a world that feels larger than the player
Build flexibility lets parties adapt to different combat roles

signals.label: GameAtlas editorial selection
signals.rationale: A useful Wii U expansion pick for its unusually ambitious open-world role-playing structure and mechanical exploration hook.
